spans.s:
ज a. [जि-जन्-जु-वा ड]
1 (At the
end of comp.) Born from or in,
produced or caused by, descended
from, growing in, living or being at
or in &c.; अत्रिनेत्रज, कुलज, जलज,
क्षत्रियज, अंडज, उद्भिज &c.
--2
Prepared from, made of.
--3 Belonging
to, connected with, peculiar to.
--4
Swift.
--5 Victorious, conquering.
--जः
1 A father.
--2 Production,
birth.
--3 Poison.
--4 An imp or
goblin.
--5 A conqueror.
--6 Lustre.
--7 N. of Viṣṇu.
--8 N. of Śiva.
--9
Enjoyment.
--10 Speed, swiftness.
--11 (In prosody) One of the eight
syllabic feet (गण).

1 A mother.
--2 A husband's
brother's wife.
--3 A race, tribe.
